prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +1.7% after noise correction across 7 tests with 3 wins, though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 5 tests with 1 win, though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
Path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests, averaging +0.1% after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (adoption, new_flow; adoption, new_screen; adoption, redesign) with only 1 test each.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as seen in rounds 6, 7, and 19 where noise-corrected impact exceeded predictions.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 5 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.7% after noise correction, 7 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality selection screen: Adds a new personality trait selector screen before picking a pet companion. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9%; adding trait customization builds early emotional attachment.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign in step before photo upload: Reorders sign-in to take place immediately after picking a friend and before custom photo upload. (why: Support logs show 8 emails about pets missing or reset after re-login, and 3 custom upload bugs; early sign-in secures account state before heavy asset generation.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing account sync hint on sign in: Displays an explicit hint confirming that signing in restores existing pets associated with the user account. (why: Support received 8 emails specifically regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop background rendering progress indicator: Displays detailed progress stages and estimated completion time during the waiting step. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s (median 201s), causing users to assume the app has frozen.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Instant activation promise path copy: Updates choose_path headline and hints to explicitly state estimated time commitments for each path. (why: choose_path has a mean time of 514s and 76.2% conversion, indicating hesitation around expected effort.)
5: [adoption, layout] Full bleed visual layout for photo upload: Changes the photo upload screen layout to full bleed with simplified drag-and-drop instructions. (why: Adoption step has the biggest drop (60.9% conversion) and support reported 3 custom pet upload/generation issues.)
6: [finish, incentive] Desktop shortcut interaction guide badge: Adds a desktop shortcut interaction tip badge explaining mouse controls on the home intro screen. (why: 3 support emails reported user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop system tray readiness notification toggle: Adds a desktop notification button on the waiting screen to alert users when rendering finishes. (why: Median waiting time is 201s and mean is 2336s; users tab away and miss completion.)

scores.note: Targets highest drop step, but adding a new screen has low past lift (+0.4%) and high cost.
Strong support mail alignment and highest historical confidence (+1.7% avg).
Low cost config hint directly backed by 8 support emails.
Addresses long 2336s mean waiting time that causes users to drop.
Low cost copy tweak, but choose_path redesigns historically yield minimal impact (+0.1%).
Combines lowest funnel step (60.9%) with support email issues on custom uploads.
Finish step redesigns have proven positive history (+1.2%) and address explicit user confusion.
Helps re-engage users tabbing away during long waits, but requires new native feature implementation.
